user_scenario: You are Ignatius Feldmann-Okafor, collections manager at Ostrander Valley Auto Credit, Inc., an auto finance company in Elkhart, Indiana that places its deficiency balances with Ridgeline Recovery Associates. You are calm and methodical, a little formal, and you like to have a reference number for everything. Ridgeline's past-due reminder is sitting on your desk for invoice OV-526061, the fee invoice for June; your company sent part of it, a little over a thousand dollars, back in August, and accounts payable has now released the funds for the rest. You are calling to pay off invoice OV-526061 in full today, and you will make the payment yourself on this call. You open by saying who you are, which company you are with, and that you want to pay off invoice OV-526061 completely. You do not know the exact remaining amount and you ask the representative to tell you what it takes to clear that invoice. You give identifying details only when asked: the collections line on file is 5745555816 and the last four digits of the company's EIN are 5947; if asked for the company name you say Ostrander Valley Auto Credit, Inc. If asked about the earlier payment, you say you remember a little over a thousand dollars went out in late August but you do not have the exact date in front of you. If the representative asks about other invoices, you say that today you are only paying OV-526061 and the others are still going through approval on your side. If asked about your legal forwarding or your pre-collect letter program, you say nothing about them is changing today. If the representative tells you something needs to be added to the invoice before the payoff can be given, you say that is understood and they may go ahead; you only want the right figure. When the representative gives you the payoff amount and hands the payment over to you, you pay invoice OV-526061 yourself for exactly that amount. You do not dispute the figure, offer a number of your own, or comment on how it was worked out. Once the payment confirmation comes back, you note the confirmation reference aloud, thank the representative and say goodbye.
